note: First real QDQ path. TensorRT-RTX 1.6 has no --int8 flag; engines come from QuantizeLinear in ONNX. GroupNorm is still on the graph that works.

smoke_int8_no_gn.init: transplant conv weights from q540 student_best
smoke_int8_no_gn.lesson: Dropping GN is not a free INT8 prep. Plateau peak +0.192 on hold-out (need +0.25). Lobby +0.64 / skip +0.47 is the easy room. No QDQ on this graph.

qdq_on_gn_smoke.lesson: TRT-RTX will build a QDQ engine on the GN smoke graph. It is slower than FP16 (6.60 vs 5.03 ms mean) and drops below +0.25 dB. INT8 is not a win until a no-GN student holds quality.
